in_sanskrit.name: दत्तु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is given or bestowed

in_marathi.name: Dattu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dattu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dattu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Datta’, which means ‘given’, ‘gifted’, or ‘granted’. In Hindu mythology, Dattatreya is a form of the god Mahadeva, who is believed to be the giver of all knowledge and blessings. The name Dattu symbolizes the divine gift of knowledge, wisdom, and spiritual growth.
